goal: Check the release gate: the sign-off, tests, rollback plan and security checks a release needs before it goes…
use: Check the release gate: the sign-off, tests, rollback plan and security checks a release needs before it goes to production. Use when a release is about to be promoted.

steps.note: Read the release scope. List the changes in the release, and the services they touch.
Check the tests. The release needs its test results and a note of any skipped tests.
Check the security checks. Confirm the security gates passed for this release, and list any open high findings.
Check the rollback. A tested rollback path must exist, with the steps written down.
Check the sign-off. A named owner must approve.
Report. A pass or fail verdict, with the reasons, and what must be fixed before the release can go.
